about: The Private Markets section of the site, as Vasco wants it (2 November 2026): one page for the department (description, overview of what it does, target firms), and from it a page per desk (Private Equity, VC & Growth, Fintech, Real Assets) with the same kind of information for that desk only: description, what the desk does, target firms, reports, events and team. Everything below says where it comes from. 'drafted' means written by Vasco's assistant from the material in this package, on Vasco's instruction, for the desk's VP to confirm. Team members are in people/03-private-markets/.

desks.name: Private Equity
desks.line: Private Equity: how buyout funds find, value and finance deals, with a monthly Deal of the Month, paper LBO workshops, mock interviews and the annual Spanish Mid-Market PE Review.
desks.line_source: drafted from Fabian Seher's material (his events, reports and page suggestions); for Fabian to confirm

what_the_desk_does.item: Deal of the Month: one buyout or mid-market deal a month, from short deal notes to a full investment memo
Technical training: accounting and valuation fundamentals for PE interviews, three-statement links, EV to equity bridge and LBO mechanics
Paper LBO workshops: building a paper LBO under time pressure, as tested in PE interviews
CV screening and mock interviews for PE and IB recruiting
Roundtables and coffee chats with PE professionals and alumni (Industry Profiles documenting them are planned, none published yet)
PE Case Competition: teams analyse a buyout case and pitch to a jury of PE professionals

desks.name: Real Assets
desks.line: Real Assets: deep dives into real estate, infrastructure and the energy transition.
desks.description: We are the Real Assets team of the ESADE Master’s Finance Club, a group of finance students who love real estate, infrastructure and the energy transition. We dig into real deals and market data, share what we find, and help each other get ready for a career in private markets.

what_the_desk_does.item: Market Insights: a quarterly report on where capital is flowing across real estate, infrastructure and energy
Deal breakdowns: live transactions taken apart, structure, pricing, financing and why the buyer bought
Sector deep dives: focused research on themes such as data centres, logistics, living sectors and the grid
Modelling workshops: hands-on sessions building real estate and infrastructure models, from appraisals to waterfalls
Industry sessions: talks and coffee chats with practitioners and ESADE alumni working in real assets
Recruiting prep: technical drills, case studies and mock interviews for real estate and infrastructure roles
